headline: ADM Tronics Raises $1.55 Million and Appoints Former Siemens CEO
summary: ADM Tronics has raised $1.55 million in funding and appointed a former Siemens CEO to its leadership.
why: Capital raises dilute existing shareholders while executive appointments signal shifts in corporate governance and strategic direction.
